purpose: P01 of the Outbreak real-city pipeline: prove the geographic pipeline on about 1 km² of central Borås (road topology, scale, chunks, terrain, reproducibility). Not for Roblox rendering as a whole; the first Roblox PoC uses a ~300 m subset.

place.name: Borås
place.selection: Best of 121 candidate 1 km squares on a 100 m grid within 500 m of Nominatim's Borås centre (57.7210839, 12.9407407, node 1643360977), scored from one Overpass download (OSM as of 2026-10-07T09:45:54Z): shared-node road junctions x2, cycles in the road graph (route alternatives) x2, buildings x1.5, large public and commercial buildings x1, highway classes x1, pedestrian-street length x1, main-road length x0.75, alleys and passages x0.5, bridges and layered roads x0.5, green x0.5, water x0.5, surface-model relief x0.5, each divided by its maximum over the candidates. The chosen square is centred 100 m west of Nominatim's centre.

terrain.attribution: Terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
terrain.license: Copernicus DEM GLO-30: Copernicus DEM licence (free of charge, attribution required)
terrain.primary_source: Lantmäteriet Markhöjdmodell (1 m ground model) is preferred for Swedish places but needs LANTMATERIET_* credentials in .env; none were configured, so fetch_terrain.py used its documented fallback, Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30 m surface model, which prepare_city cleans of mapped buildings and forests).

policy.street_view: Not a source. No Google Street View or Google imagery was read; OSM elements whose source tags name Google or Street View would make the snapshot invalid (street_view_tags).
policy.network: Live OpenStreetMap and terrain services were read once, when this snapshot was made. Builds read only these files.
